entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed. I was hoping to return a helmet I bought.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a customer for so long, and I've never had an issue. The problem is the color... it just looks so different from the website. I feel awful about it, but I haven't even opened it. The box is unopened, sitting right here. I really needed that money back for an unexpected bill.
I understand completely. Let me just pull that order up for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the helmet was delivered 30 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy... I was worried I missed the window.
No reason to worry. For an item like a helmet, you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so much.

Of course. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help, Alex. I really appreciate your understanding.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
